w: A Fuldol festival (Festival of colors) was organised in the beautiful gardens of the Yatch Club by the shores of Lake Victoria. Swamishri sprinkled colored water on more than 250 devotees. In the evening assembly 120 youths had pledged to give up addictions. As a symbol of their commitment Swamishri was offered a special garland.

w: At 9.50 a.m., a yagna was performed in the presence of Swamishri at the BAPS tin-city for the consecration rituals of murtis to be installed in the villages of Pramukh Swami Nagar, Gunatitnagar, Narayannagar, Bhuj, Yoginagar and Shrijinagar. The Vedic yagna had 60 yagna-kunds and 482 couples as participants. After the rituals, Swamishri blessed the assembly.
Students of BAPS Swaminarayan Gurukul, Gondal recited shlokas and kirtans during Swamishri's walking and presented a kirtan bhakti program in Swamishri's puja.

In the evening assembly, after Pujya Viveksagar Swami's speech, the Gurukul students performed a 'Mashal Nrutya' and presented a debate, 'Which is Superior: Study or Character?' Finally, Swamishri blessed the assembly.

In the morning devotees of Dar-es-Salaam, Mwanza and other centres in Tanzania held a special assembly in honour of Shri Harikrishna Maharaj in the presence of Swamishri. After Swamishri’s evening walk, the Tanzanian Foreign Minister, Jakaya Mrisho Kikwete, came to meet him. Swamishri blessed him, “May you do good service for the country and earn the respect of the people.”

In the morning at about 10.30 am Swamishri inaugurated Sahajanand Darshan that portrays the universal messages of ahimsa, endeavor, faith, austerity, etc. Thereafter Swamishri saw all the audioanimatronics and film presentations. Thereafter Swamishri inaugurated Sankruti Vihar – the boat ride exhibition on India’s glorious heritage. Swamishri sat in the boat with Thakorji and viewed the 10 minute boat ride exhibition.

A youth came to meet Swamishri. Many years before Swamishri had made great efforts in helping him give up his drinking habit. The youth had given it up altogether but he was still habituated to smoking. When Swamishri told him to give up smoking the youth replied, “The bigger habit has gone altogether. Now, it’s only the smaller one that remains.” Swamishri advised, “It’s good that you’ve give up the bigger one, but if you keep the smaller one then it will allow the bigger one to enter once again. So make sincere efforts to give it up.”

To please Bhagwan Swaminarayan and Guru Pramukh Swami Maharaj children, youths and senior devotees perform austerities, pilgrimages or other devotional means. The spiritual endeavors performed by the devotees during Swamishri's visit to the local centers are congratulatory and worthy of recognition. It also reflects Swamishri's divinity for inspiring such spiritual efforts in children, teenagers and devotees.

For the foundation-stone laying ceremony many devotees performed various sadhnas: Extra malas : 580 devotees; extra dandvats : 431 devotees; Janmangal Namavali: 417; one meal a day till the shilanyas ceremony: 147; liquid fasts for 3 days, 5 days or 7 days: 153; abstaining from eating sweet foods: 252; and daily darshan of sanskardham: 116 devotees.

Today after the morning puja, the musician sadhus of Sarangpur came to put on him a garland prepared by the Bhavnagar girls' group. They requested, "Just as Swamibapa said 'I love you all', you too have said 'I love you all', so please love us."
"We love you more than you love us." This one sentence of Mahant Swami Maharaj's filled everyone's hearts.

"We know that we have love for God, but God and the Sant have far more love for us than we do..." Everyone experienced that the legacy of the Gunatit one who said this is exactly preserved in Swamishri.

A question was put to Mahant Swami Maharaj: "Shastriji Maharaj's sankalp (resolve) was the Sarangpur mandir. Yogiji Maharaj's sankalp was Akshardham in Delhi, and Pramukh Swami Maharaj's sankalp is Akshardham in Robbinsville. In the same way, please kindly write down what your sankalp is."
Swamishri wrote: "That Pramukh Swami Maharaj's sankalp (his very own sankalp), Robbinsville, be completed: that alone is our sankalp too."
This is the devotion of our gurus to their guru: they merge their own resolves into fulfilling the resolves of their gurus.

Mahant Swami Maharaj had gone to the ISKCON temple for darshan. From there he was to come straight to our mandir, but on the way the sadhus mentioned that our Shayona warehouse was just a short distance from there. Swamishri expressed a wish to go there. The cars turned in that direction. On seeing Swamishri, our satsangis doing seva there were beside themselves with joy.
Thanking Swamishri, Sureshbhai Depala said, "Swami! This morning I wished that you would come here, and knowing my heart, you caught my wish and came here."
Every action of Swamishri has a purpose.
After that, Mahant Swami Maharaj sat in the car and left for the mandir. In the car, Tarun Patel was introduced.
Swamishri said, "I have known him since 1966."
The attendant sadhu asked him, "Which village?"
Tarunbhai said, "Karamsad."
Swamishri immediately exclaimed, "Mosal (mother's family home) Bhadran!"
Like Pramukh Swami Maharaj, how personally Swamishri too knows each and every devotee!

Mahant Swami Maharaj lay down on his bed. Amrutkirtandas Swami, as if expressing gratitude, said, "Swami! We had the joy of Pramukh Swami Maharaj's darshan while he ate, while he walked and while he retired. The senior sadhus used to tell us that they got the privilege of bathing Pramukh Swami Maharaj, of serving his feet and all that, but Pramukh Swami Maharaj has gone.... We wondered, 'Now what? Now we will not get any of these privileges. We will not get such joy.' But you have given us all these joys. Now it does not feel as if anything is left."
Swamishri spoke a wonderful sentence: "The Satpurush never leaves the earth; he holds on."

Truly, Swamishri has held on to all of us. He has not let us feel at all that Pramukh Swami Maharaj has gone. He has made us feel constantly that Swamishri's footsteps are moving among us and with us.
Here, Mahant Swami Maharaj spoke with heartfelt enthusiasm to 29 young men who were eager to set out on the noble path of the sadhu: "Shriji Maharaj is supreme, right!"
Everyone said "Yes."

"Likewise Gunatitanand Swami is also supreme, and this choice you have made is supreme, world best! Where would anyone make such a choice? Only one with knowledge would make it! In any case, this choice you have made is the best. We are not saying this because we are sadhus; it simply is so."
